card.name: The word minutes after 60
card.fires_on: The word "minutes" right after the number 60 (or the 0 in 60) when a label gives a waiting time or timing window around a dose or procedure.

modes.label: 60 minutes before or after
modes.description: "minutes" follows 60 in a wait time before or after taking a drug or starting an activity.

modes.label: 60 split or hyphenated
modes.description: The pole also fires on the 0 of 60 or on "-minute" in a 60-minute infusion or time limit.
modes.example: Complete administration within 6<<0>> minutes of dilution.
